verdict.rationale: Slack is genuinely bidirectional: incidents can be created, acknowledged and resolved from Slack, and Better Stack says it syncs all events between Slack and the dashboard (docs-58, docs-38). The other named tools are thinner. Teams appears only as an alert channel and a place to call the AI SRE. GitHub covers only AI-suggested fix pull requests, and ticketing is shown for Linear rather than Jira. Missing for 10: Jira integration, Zoom integration, two-way state sync for Teams and GitHub, independent or hands-on corroboration.
